<!--
Quarto 1.10 exposes `lof` and `lot` as Typst options, but its stock Typst
 template does not emit the corresponding outlines. These native Typst outlines

 until Quarto provides direct emission for this backend.
-->

```{=typst}
// Justified text leaves large gaps in narrow table columns.
#show table: set par(justify: false)
#pagebreak()
#outline(target: figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-fig"), title: [List of Figures])
#pagebreak()
#outline(target: figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-tbl"), title: [List of Tables])
#pagebreak()
```
